query:
WITH current AS (
                    SELECT start_at FROM rb_team WHERE id = $1 FOR UPDATE
                ), updated AS (
                    UPDATE rb_team
                    SET is_locked = TRUE, start_at = COALESCE(start_at, $2)
                    WHERE id = $1
                    RETURNING id
                )
                SELECT current.start_at IS NULL AS "started!"
                FROM current JOIN updated ON TRUE
